diagnostics.message: an Attack target is a selector that ranks your own beacons (`side: OWN`, or no side); it must rank known enemy beacons (`side: ENEMY_KNOWN`).
diagnostics.beginner: A Defend beacon protects your own beacons, and an Attack beacon attacks an enemy's, so a selector there has to look among the right side's beacons.

diagnostics.message: Attack mandate settings have no effect until S2's Attack mandate lands; they are refused rather than ignored.
diagnostics.beginner: An Attack beacon cannot be given settings in this build yet.
